remoteaccess.config.title: Remote Access
remoteaccess.config.searchRadius.tooltip: Cubic scan radius around the player, in blocks.
remoteaccess.config.reachLimit.tooltip: Hard cap on switching distance, in blocks. Keep near vanilla reach (~4.5) so the server accepts the interaction.
remoteaccess.config.prevKey.tooltip: Key for "previous workstation". A GLFW key name without the GLFW_KEY_ prefix (e.g. A, LEFT, LEFT_BRACKET); single letters/digits work directly.
remoteaccess.config.nextKey.tooltip: Key for "next workstation". Same format as Previous Key.
remoteaccess.config.iconSize.tooltip: Frame size of the on-screen navigation icons, in pixels.
remoteaccess.config.sortMode.tooltip: Ordering strategy for the prev/next cycle.
remoteaccess.config.showSwitchMessage.to: Show a brief action-bar message naming the workstation switched to.
remoteaccess.config.showIcons.tooltip: Draw the left/right navigation icons inside supported screens.
remoteaccess.config.playSound.tooltip: Play a directional "swipe" sound when switching workstations.
remoteaccess.config.slideAnimation.toolt: Slide the navigation icons in from the swipe direction on each switch.
remoteaccess.config.blacklist.tooltip: Block IDs (e.g. minecraft:beacon) to never treat as a workstation.
